climate change, and unmanaged recreaBon, and FERC must ensure that the Pipeline does not further harm this
threatened ecosystem. The enBre region of West Texas, and especially Otero Mesa, is full of sites sacred to Tribes
indigenous to the region, including the Carrizo Comecrudo Tribe of Texas.

Salt Flats in Hudspeth County, Texas. Not only are the salt ﬂats an important historical site that aTracts hikers and other
visitors, they are home to the incredibly rare and criBcally imperiled Salt Playa Fairy Shrimp. The Bureau of Land

decimate important Fairy Shrimp habitat.

jusBce community in Southern New Mexico. The EPA already recognizes Chaparral as a non-aTainment area for ozone,

Desert Southwest Pipeline.
